arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM (SELECT id, date, lag(date) OVER (PARTITION BY card_id ORDER BY date, id) AS previous FROM transactions) WHERE previous IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%s', date) - strftime('%s', previous) < 120
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions that came less than 2 minutes (under 120 seconds) after the previous transaction on the same card. A gap of exactly 2 minutes is left out.
assumptions: Each card's first transaction has no previous transaction, so it is never counted.
Transactions on the same card with the same timestamp are ordered by id. The second one counts as having a gap of zero.
All transactions are included, whether or not they have a fraud label, have errors or have negative amounts.
